question: How are the deities arranged in the Shiva principle?
premises: Above that is the Shiva principle.
In the four directions there are established deities.
At the center is the pervading, sky-natured, infinite lord together with those who share his shakti.
inference: The Shiva principle is organized with the infinite sky-natured lord and his shakti-sharers at the center and other deities established in the four directions.
uncertainties: The exact identities of the deities in the four directions are not named in this verse.
plain_english: Then comes the Shiva principle. There, deities are established in the four directions, and at the center is the pervading, sky-natured, infinite lord together with those who partake of his shakti.
